author: Carlos Nunes
text: How are you, Igor Pavlov? My name is Carlos Nunes and I'm from Brazil. I really admire your work with 7-zip, which I've been using for over 20 years. Do you have any plans to release the Dark version of 7-Zip in future versions? I ask because all software is migrating to this mode, which also greatly facilitates eye comfort, especially for those with eye problems related to brightness. Dark mode is not just a matter of visual aesthetics, but also to help those who may suffer from some eye disorder in which the brightness of the screens causes great discomfort when used in Light Mode. Thank you for your attention and thank you very much for 7-Zip.
